ratios.label: Earnings per share
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the EPS row does not reconcile with the statement's own earnings. It reads 0.4393 ZAR for FY2026 against 3.8774 implied by net profit 247418000 over 63810244 shares, a factor of 0.11. One of the two rows is filed in a different unit, so the earnings per share is not verified. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 0.52 against price over EPS 4.55) and the filing does not settle which row is right. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
